overhead: What the overhead camera sees, with the detector's output: every cap found, classified by colour and located on the bench to about a millimetre.
overview: The cell before a run: eight capped tubes in the pickup zone, three racks, the arm folded back so the overhead camera has a clear view.
grasp: The gripper closing on a cap. The wrist camera read this tube's QR label a moment earlier, from 7 cm above it.
carry: Carrying a tube to its rack. Each move is a waypoint solved exactly by closed-form inverse kinematics.
sorted: The same bench after the run: every tube in the rack its cap colour belongs to, and one row per tube in the sort log.
fallen: A harder start: two tubes knocked over. The overhead camera tells them apart from standing ones by the outline of the cap.
inspect: A fallen tube held level over clear table, so the overhead camera can see which end is the body before it is stood up.
righted: Stood back up at the righting station, cap on top. From here it is sorted like any other tube.
